resources.string: Needs root (Magisk). Tap one of the test buttons once and grant superuser access when Magisk asks.

Version %1$s

Switches the system theme between light and dark from the ambient light sensor, once the light level has stayed on one side of the threshold for the debounce time. Needs root.
